This '''list of most followed users on Instagram''' contains the top 50 accounts with the most followers on the social photo-sharing platform [[Instagram]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://socialblade.com/instagram/top/100/followers|title=Top 100 Instagram Users by Followers- Socialblade Instagram Stats {{!}} Instagram Statistics|work=Socialblade|accessdate=March 17, 2017}}</ref> As of {{date|today|mdy}}, the most followed user is [[Instagram]]'s own account, with over 200 million followers.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.vanityfair.com/style/2016/08/justin-bieber-deletes-instagram-selena-gomez|title=Justin Bieber Deletes His Instagram Account in Wake of Selena Gomez Feud|work=[[Vanity Fair (magazine)|Vanity Fair]]|date=August 16, 2016|accessdate=February 17, 2017}}</ref>
